The avatar itself is stored inline as a base64 data-URI string in the `avatar_url` column of the `user` table (not as a separate file/attachment); the Postgres and MySQL drivers have equivalent `ListUsers` implementations at store/db/postgres/user.go and store/db/mysql/user.go selected via the `s.driver` interface.
